packs.name: Faith
packs.description: The church year (Palm Sunday through Christmas), church life pictures, a verse on Thanksgiving, bedtime verses on the clock, and a picture with a verse every Sunday from five series: the Lord's Day, the Ten Commandments, the Trinity, the 1689 Confession and the books of the Bible.

packs.name: Outings
packs.description: Amusement and water parks, trains, the zoo, the aquarium, fairs, hikes, lake days, pumpkin patches, apple picking and Christmas lights.

packs.name: Kids' activities
packs.description: Game days (baseball, soccer, football), recitals, school plays, movie nights and Scouts.
